input.idea: An online shop for restored vintage road bikes, around €450 each

brand.name: Second Wind Cycles
brand.tagline: Classic steel road bikes, restored and ready to ride
brand.voice: warm, knowledgeable, a bit nerdy about old frames, never snobbish

report.customer: Riders aged 30 to 60 who want a classic steel road bike that rides well today, but have no time or tools to restore one
report.pain: Second-hand listings are a gamble: worn parts, wrong sizes and no one to ask after buying

offer.what: A restored vintage road bike, fully serviced, sized to the buyer, shipped boxed or picked up

competitors.name: Private sellers on second-hand marketplaces
competitors.gap: Cheap but unchecked; no service, no sizing help

competitors.name: Bike shops selling new entry-level road bikes
competitors.gap: New and guaranteed, but no classic look or story

risks: Few bikes per month: restoring takes hours
Shipping bikes is costly and can damage them
Buyers want to see a bike before paying €450

plan.headline: Sell 6 restored steel road bikes at 450 EUR in 30 days by reaching riders already searching for them, proving the sizing-and-service promise with the first buyers.

goal.metric: Paid pre-orders for restored bikes, each one BCH payment received on the website
goal.why: Six paid pre-orders equal 2,700 EUR and match the stated limit of 6 bikes per batch; it proves that strangers will pay before seeing the bike, which is the main risk.
goal.how_counted: Count each BCH payment received on the website for a bike order, once per bike. Do not count inquiries, messages or reserved slots without payment.

customer.who: Riders aged 30 to 60 who want a classic steel road bike that rides well today, but have no time or tools to restore one, and who fear buying a worn or wrong-size second-hand bike.

places.place: Retro Classic Road forum on Retrobike, classic road bike threads
places.when: Evenings and weekends, when people browse and post questions

places.place: Bike Forums Classic & Vintage section, threads about rust and classic steel frames
places.when: Evenings, when owners ask for repair and frame advice

places.place: Singletrack World thread on fitting modern groupsets to older frames
places.when: Whenever a rider is planning a rebuild and needs compatibility answers

places.place: Used markets and private listings for older road bikes, where buyers meet a bike before paying
places.when: Weekends, when people go to look at bikes in person

channels.name: Retrobike Retro Classic Road forum
channels.why: The buyers already ask questions about classic road bikes here, and the forum fits a nerdy, helpful brand voice; its activity dates are unclear, so check before relying on it.
channels.first_action: Create a free account on the Retro Classic Road forum this week and read the last 20 threads to note what sizing and condition questions riders ask.

channels.name: Helpful answers in Bike Forums Classic & Vintage threads
channels.why: Riders there post about rust and steel frames, so a clear answer followed by a link to the shop reaches people who already want a restored frame.
channels.first_action: Reply this week to one open rust or classic steel frame thread with a practical tip and a short note that Second Wind Cycles restores and sizes such bikes, without a hard sales push.

channels.name: Sizing guide and free fit check by email on the website
channels.why: We assume buyers hesitate because of sizing risk, so a free sizing guide and a reply by email gives them trust before paying 450 EUR.
channels.first_action: Write a one-page sizing guide with a short questionnaire (height, inseam, riding style) and publish it on the website before the first forum post.

rejected.name: Paid social or search ads
rejected.why_not: Paid ads reach broad audiences and cost money before any bike is proven; the buyer is a niche forum reader, and our budget is too small to test reach.

rejected.name: Market stall or flyers at a local event
rejected.why_not: The research found no local paid channel, no events in the next 30 days and no local prices, so a stall cost and date cannot be planned yet.

tiers.label: Free start: forums, guide and direct replies

lines.for: Free account and reading threads, then helpful replies
Free account and helpful replies on rust and steel frame threads
Writing the guide and answering email questions yourself

tiers.label: Small test: sizing help and sample photos

Forum membership or sponsored thread only if the forum offers one, with a verified price

budget.reallocate_rule: On days 22 to 30, look at which channel sent the most BCH pre-order payments; move the unspent budget of the lowest channel to the channel with the most paid orders, and keep at least 10 percent unspent as reserve.

weeks.aim: Publish the sizing guide and set up forum accounts so buyers can check size before paying.

Post one helpful answer to a sizing question and link to the sizing guide on our website.

Post the offer in the classic road bike section with the sizing guide link and a clear price.
Reply to threads that ask for a classic steel road frame with the offer, the price and the link to our website.
Send the waitlist email with the offer details and ask people to reply with their height, inseam and riding style.

weeks.aim: Answer buyer questions, confirm the first paid pre-orders, and close the batch at six bikes.

days.action: Reply by email to every buyer who asked about size or photos, and send the photos of the bike you are restoring.
Answer any open buyer question in the threads and share the sizing guide link once more, without pressure.
Post a last call that says how many bikes are left in this batch, based only on the paid orders on our website.
Send the last call email to the waitlist with the remaining places and the link to our website.
Check the paid pre-orders on our website, count them, and send a short thank you message to the people who helped.

posts.hook: Sizing a classic steel frame is the part most listings skip.
posts.body: If you are looking at an older steel road bike, check the frame size against your height and inseam, not just the number on the tag. We restore classic steel road bikes, service them fully and size each one to its buyer. Our sizing guide is free on our website, and we answer sizing emails ourselves.
posts.cta: Read the sizing guide on our website.

posts.hook: Rust on steel: clean it first, then decide.
posts.body: Light surface rust often comes off with a gentle abrasive and a dry cloth. Deep pitting needs a frame builder's opinion before you ride. Check the chainstays and the bottom bracket shell first. If you want a bike that is already checked, Second Wind Cycles restores classic steel road bikes at 450 EUR, sized to you.
posts.cta: Ask us about sizing on our website.

posts.hook: Not sure which size you need?
posts.body: Send us your height, inseam and how you ride. We reply by email with a size suggestion before you pay anything. Each bike is restored, fully serviced and sized to its buyer for 450 EUR. You can pay with Bitcoin Cash (BCH) on our website, and bikes ship boxed or can be picked up.
posts.cta: Get the sizing guide on our website.

copy.message: Hi, I am starting Second Wind Cycles, where we restore old steel road bikes and sell them fully serviced, sized to the buyer, for 450 EUR. Would you read our sizing guide on our website and tell me honestly if it makes sense? If you know anyone who wants a classic road bike that rides well today, I would be glad if you passed it on. Thank you.

email.body: Thank you for joining the list. We are restoring a first batch of six classic steel road bikes at 450 EUR each. Each one is fully serviced and sized to its buyer. local.fact: A newcomer found a cheap Peugeot at a local used market, showing that private sellers and local markets are part of how riders get classic bikes.
A broken chainstay on a vintage Italian steel frame is a job for a local frame builder with a good reputation.

assumptions: Riders in Europe will buy a bike ordered online with BCH payment, which may be unfamiliar to them; check how many ask about it.
The forum activity dates are unclear, so confirm that Retro Classic Road threads are recent before investing hours there.
Six restored bikes can be made in 30 days by one person at the stated limit; check restoration hours against the batch size.
Shipping cost and damage risk are not priced here; confirm a boxed shipping quote before taking the first order.
The research found no European local groups or newsletters for this buyer; the forums found are mostly UK and US.

decision.scale_if: 6 paid pre-orders arrive by day 30 and at least 3 of them came from forum or sizing-guide contact, so the channel can grow to a second batch.
decision.adjust_if: Between 2 and 5 paid pre-orders arrive; keep the forum channels, rewrite the sizing guide and buyer questions, and move the reserve to the channel that sent the most buyers.
decision.stop_if: Fewer than 2 paid pre-orders arrive and fewer than 5 buyers ask about a bike before paying; pause the batch and test a pickup-only offer in one local used market before restoring more bikes.
